examples.title: Secure Form Input
examples.description: Form input with client-side validation and server-side sanitization
examples.code:
<Stack direction="vertical" gap="xs">
  <Label htmlFor="username">Username</Label>
  <Textfield 
    id="username"
    data-size="medium"
    pattern="[a-zA-Z0-9_]{3,20}"
    maxLength={20}
    onChange={(e) => {
      // Client-side: restrict input
      const value = e.target.value.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_]/g, '');
      setValue(value);
    }}
  />
  <Text variant="caption" size="xs">
    Only letters, numbers, and underscores allowed
  </Text>
</Stack>
examples.note: Always validate and sanitize on server-side as well

examples.title: Secure File Upload
examples.description: File upload with type and size validation
examples.code:
<FileUploader
  accept=".pdf,.doc,.docx"
  maxSize={5 * 1024 * 1024}
  onFileSelect={(file) => {
    // Validate file type
    const allowedTypes = ['application/pdf', 'application/msword'];
    if (!allowedTypes.includes(file.type)) {
      setError('Invalid file type');
      return;
    }
    // Validate file size
    if (file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
      setError('File too large');
      return;
    }
    handleUpload(file);
  }}
  error={error}
/>
examples.note: Always validate file type and size on server-side

examples.title: Modal SM
examples.code:
<Dialog open={isOpen} onClose={handleClose} size="sm">
  <Dialog.Header>
    <Heading level={2} data-size="medium">Modal Title</Heading>
  </Dialog.Header>
  <Dialog.Content>
    <Paragraph>Modal content</Paragraph>
  </Dialog.Content>
  <Dialog.Footer>
    <Stack direction="horizontal" justify="end" gap="sm">
      <Button data-variant="tertiary" onClick={handleClose}>Cancel</Button>
      <Button data-color="accent">Confirm</Button>
    </Stack>
  </Dialog.Footer>
</Dialog>

  <Heading level={2}>Section Title</Heading>
  <Grid cols={{ base: 1, md: 2 }} gap="md">

<Grid cols={{ base: 1, md: 2, lg: 3 }} gap="md">
  {Array.from({ length: 3 }).map((_, i) => (
    <Stack key={i} direction="vertical" gap="xs">
      <Label htmlFor={`field${i}`}>Field {i + 1}</Label>
      <Textfield id={`field${i}`} data-size="medium" />
    </Stack>
  ))}
</Grid>

examples.title: Modal SM
examples.code:
<Dialog open={isOpen} onClose={handleClose} size="sm">
  <Dialog.Header>
    <Heading level={2} data-size="medium">Modal Title</Heading>
  </Dialog.Header>
  <Dialog.Content>
    <Paragraph>Modal content</Paragraph>
  </Dialog.Content>
  <Dialog.Footer>
    <Stack direction="horizontal" justify="end" gap="sm">
      <Button data-variant="tertiary" onClick={handleClose}>Cancel</Button>
      <Button data-color="accent">Confirm</Button>
    </Stack>
  </Dialog.Footer>
</Dialog>

  <Stack direction="horizontal" justify="end" gap="sm">

    id="text-input"
    type="text"
    data-size="medium"
    onChange={(e) => {
      // Sanitize input based on type
      const sanitized = sanitizeInput(e.target.value, 'text');
